status: pre-data rules; no formal results loaded
ratio: candidate/control latency; below one is faster; exact floating-point equality is a tie
reduction: median of the eight original ns/key values separately for each API/mode/case
round_sensitivity: retain each API round2/round1 latency and candidate/control ratio in both rounds, plus ratio of ratios; no causal order inference
four_point_ranges: min/max plus every seed/round point at identical n/hit/batch/mode; no confidence interval or pooled independent win rate
batches31_and4096: unchanged source paths; machine-code/layout/caller identity is not assumed
coupled_codegen_change: candidate SIMD body also inlines and changes frame/unrolling relative to control per-key LookupScalar calls
quality: observed mixed-query FP/complete-output checksums retained as semantic guards only; no new FPR qualification or pooled quality sample
loader: final additive committed-raw/source binding required; current summarize.load always rejects
